subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction of the secondary-agent heartbeat under `session.scope: "global"` and `session.dmScope: "per-channel-peer"` before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's narrowed hypothesis, but the likely fix touches compatibility-sensitive global session routing and the issue already carries maintainer-review/live-repro labels.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source evidence as sufficient and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests without live proof first.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until adjacent global-session and isolated-heartbeat routing issues are handled together.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage against the confirmed path.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the two most relevant adjacent heartbeat/cron routing PRs and are the strongest routing contact from current history.
